Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the first WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly stated that "The Beginning or the End" was released on "June 28, 1957". The WebSurfer search results clearly showed the film was released in 1947 (specifically February 19, 1947, per IMDb). This hallucination of a future release date (1957 instead of 1947) led to the final incorrect conclusion that "Hold Back the Night" (1956) was released first, when in reality "The Beginning or the End" (1947) was released first.
